nodes.name: Shortener
nodes.what: Turns a long web address into a short link, then sends each click to the original page
nodes.why: People share a short link, and the owner can see that the link was used

nodes.name: Client
nodes.what: The person who creates a link or clicks one
nodes.why: Every arrow in this system starts or ends with that person

nodes.name: Create
nodes.what: Makes a short link from a long address
nodes.why: Writing a link is a different path from opening one

nodes.name: Jump
nodes.what: Sends a click to the original page
nodes.why: Opening the link is the path people hit the most

nodes.name: Directory
nodes.what: Holds the map from short code to long address
nodes.why: Creating a link and opening it have to agree on the same map

nodes.name: Count
nodes.what: Remembers that a short link was used
nodes.why: The owner needs a count that does not slow the click

nodes.name: Browser
nodes.what: Asks for a short link, or opens one someone shared
nodes.why: The shortener is for a person who is not inside it

nodes.name: Create link
nodes.what: Takes a long address and returns a short link
nodes.why: Creating a link is a different job from sending a click onward

nodes.name: Code mint
nodes.what: Chooses a short code that no link uses yet
nodes.why: Two addresses must not end up on the same code

nodes.name: Redirect
nodes.what: Finds the long address for a code and points the browser at it
nodes.why: A click has to leave for the real page without waiting on counts

nodes.name: Hot cache
nodes.what: Keeps the codes people are clicking right now
nodes.why: Most clicks should not read the directory

nodes.name: Link table
nodes.what: Stores each code and the address it opens
nodes.why: The link still has to work after the cache drops it

nodes.name: Click stream
nodes.what: Carries the fact of a click away from the redirect
nodes.why: The person should not wait while the click is counted

nodes.name: Tallies
nodes.what: Turns clicks into numbers the owner can read
nodes.why: The owner shared the link to learn if people used it
